in_arabic.name: جادور
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من جدر بمعنى حجر أو صخر
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه المشتق من جدر، وهو الحجر أو الصخر، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنبياء آية 25: 'وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ تَصْرِيفًا وَهُمَا لَا يَجُدُرَانِ أَنْ يَكُونَا رَبَّيْنِ لِأَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ'، ويشير إلى القوة والصلابة.

in_urdu.name: جادور
in_urdu.meaning: جڑور، پتھر یا چٹان سے بنا ہوا
in_urdu.long_meaning: علم کا مشتق عربی زبان سے ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے پتھر یا چٹان، جیسے قرآن مجید میں ورد ہے: 'وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ تَصْرِيفًا وَهُمَا لَا يَجُدُرَانِ أَنْ يَكُونَا رَبَّيْنِ لِأَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ'، یہ نام طاقت اور مضبوطی کی علامت ہے.

in_hindi.name: जादुर
in_hindi.meaning: जादुर, पत्थर या चट्टान से बना हुआ
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है पत्थर या चट्टान। कुरआन में इसका उल्लेख इस प्रकार है: 'وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ تَصْرِيفًا وَهُمَا لَا يَجُدُرَانِ أَنْ يَكُونَا رَبَّيْنِ لِأَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ'। यह नाम शक्ति और मजबूती का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: جادور
in_pashto.meaning: جادور، د ډبرې يا څټان څخه جوړ شوی
in_pashto.long_meaning: دغه نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د ډبرې يا څټان څخه جوړ شوی دی. په قرآن کې يې دا ډول يادونه شوې ده: 'وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ تَصْرِيفًا وَهُمَا لَا يَجُدُرَانِ أَنْ يَكُونَا رَبَّيْنِ لِأَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ'، دا نوم د قوت او مضبوطۍ نښه ده.

in_english.name: Jadur
in_english.meaning: Strong and powerful, derived from stone or rock
in_english.long_meaning: Jadur is an Arabic-derived name meaning 'stone' or 'rock'. It appears in the Quran (Surah Al-Anbiya, Verse 25) as 'وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ تَصْرِيفًا وَهُمَا لَا يَجُدُرَانِ أَنْ يَكُونَا رَبَّيْنِ لِأَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ', signifying strength and solidity. The name symbolizes resilience and power, reflecting positive personality traits.

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name Jadur is an Arabic name, which means "the one who gives" or "the generous one." In Islamic culture, generosity is considered a virtue and an essential aspect of one's character. Jadur is a name that carries a positive meaning and a reminder of the importance of generosity and kindness in Islam. Giving and being kind to others, especially to those in need, is highly encouraged in Islamic teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jadur holds spiritual significance as it reflects the character of Allah (SWT) as the Giver of all blessings. The name is also a reminder of the importance of generosity and kindness towards others. In Islamic teachings, it is believed that giving in charity and being kind to others not only brings blessings in this world but also in the Hereafter. The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) said, "It is not allowed for the believer to be self-sufficient" (Al-Tirmidhi, 3252). By giving and being generous, one not only fulfills their social obligations but also strengthens their spiritual connection with Allah (SWT). The name Jadur is not only a reminder of one's duty to give but also a source of inspiration to live a life of generosity and kindness towards others.

historical_references.reference: Al-Maqrizi and Al-Sakhawi mention Jadur as a caliph of Egypt during the Ayyubid period around 1260 AD.
historical_references.context: Jadur was a local ruler who seized power in Egypt and ruled as a de facto independent caliph for a short period during the Ayyubid era. He was challenged by various rivals, including the Ayyubid sultan, before being overthrown.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Masudi writes about Jadur as a Shia leader in Iraq during the Buyid period around 962 AD. The name Jadur carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Jadur was a Shia leader who led a rebellion against the Sunni Buyid rulers in Iraq. He claimed to have the hidden Imam's support and was able to gain a significant following before being defeated and executed.
